OpenAI’s embedded-assessment announcement is indexed as naming Apollo Research, METR, Transluce and Goodfire as independent assessors under signed agreements. The primary page could not be retrieved, so this entry is limited to the indexed statement.

An agreement to assess a model is not an assessment result or a guarantee of unrestricted access. Scope, disclosure rights, timing and findings remain unknown from the available excerpt.
highlights: Access and publication terms remain unknown
Independence requires more than a headline
